description: This script manages USB mount and unmount events, interacting with system components, logging, and sending notifications via external binaries. It is called by a systemd unit file to handle USB device hotplug events.

methods.name: log_msg
methods.description: Logs a message to the log file with timestamp and process ID.

methods.name: sendMountChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends an event notification about USB mount or unmount change via external binary.

methods.name: do_mount
methods.description: Handles mounting the specified USB device to the designated mount point.

methods.name: do_unmount
methods.description: Handles unmounting the specified USB device.
